subject: 33-year-old man with sculpted two-tone quiff
art_direction: 33岁男性卷起高耸双色发型，宽大棋格西装全扣合，冷灰背景里姿态松弛。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Draw an original 33-year-old man with a tall curled quiff divided into two broad color masses and a soft square jaw. His oversized checked jacket is fully buttoned over a high-neck shirt, with the checks large enough to read as graphic shapes. Use mustard, navy, and dusty mauve risograph inks on cream paper. Let one shoulder drop while the chin lifts slightly, giving him relaxed alertness. Keep facial details economical and the hair silhouette bold, avoiding photoreal skin, brand marks, jewelry clutter, or a known person likeness. Square 1024x1024. Keep the complete central silhouette within a circular crop, occupying about 70% of the canvas. Original design; no lettering, logos, or watermark.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
